Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
